description: Buy a phone number for your account (free sandbox numbers with test keys). Live numbers are billed monthly.

customer_id.description: Optional: assign the number to one of your customers

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Retries are already safe: the same call with the same inputs within 10 minutes is done once and answers with the first result. Pass your own key to dedupe across a longer gap, or a new one to repeat an identical call on purpose.

phone_number.description: The number to buy, in E.164

registration_id.description: Optional (live numbers): the registration this number should send for. Without it the number follows your account's registration.

name: purchase_number
title: Purchase number
